desc: Protect your hearing and communicate effectively with the all-new Walker's Cloak Dual Mic Electronic Hearing Protection. Featuring durable ABS plastic earcups, these over-the-ear earmuffs come equipped with two high-definition speakers and dual Hi-Gain omnidirectional microphones designed to deliver clear, balanced sounds at safe levels, allowing you to communicate effectively while a convenient volume control keeps you in full control of the volume level for added comfort and reliability. Onboard sound-activated compression (SAC) technology allows you to hear even the softest of sounds while also boasting a 23-25dB Noise Reduction Rating (NRR) to help protect your hearing from loud, harmful sounds. This over-the-ear headset features a padded, non-slip headband and a convenient folding design for comfortable all-day wear, while wire-adjustable pads deliver a custom fit for added comfort.
